the effect of age and short- term cold stress on the activity of succinate dehydrogenase in the whole brain and mid brain and the respiratory rate in the mid brain of the lizard, Lacerta agilis.
the effect of age and cold stress on SDHA activity and oxygen consumption in the brain of the lizard, Lacerta vivipara.
the effect of age and short term cold stress on the activity of succinate dehydrogenase and oxygen consumption of brain tissue in lizards.

the old lizards are more vulnerable to short-term cold stress than the young lizards.
the brain of old lizards is more sensitive to cold stress than young lizards, as reflected in the depressed respiratory rates.
the cold stress-induced depression of brain SDH activity and brain respiratory rate is more pronounced in old lizards than in young ones.
